root_idea.summary: The root centers on وَثَن, an idol traditionally understood as a stone object worshipped as divine.
root_idea.development: Classical lexical evidence also records related derived uses involving becoming strong, making something abundant, and giving lavishly; these are distinct from the Quranic noun sense.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular citation form وَثَن; the Quran attests its plural form أَوْثَان.

senses.definition: A stone idol worshipped as a deity.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranically attested in the plural أَوْثَان, referring to idols taken or worshipped apart from God.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical derived use recorded with the expression اِسْتَوْثَنَ الشَّيْءُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something abundant or increase it; to give lavishly or have much of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used transitively of increasing a load or giving someone generously, and with مِنْ to indicate having or doing much of something.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The unit explicitly defines وَثَن as an idol.

cautions: The Quranic occurrences are plural forms أَوْثَان; وَثَن is used as the normalized singular dictionary headword.
